top_signals.title: China’s Slower-Than-Expected Price Gains Revive Deflation Risk
top_signals.summary: China’s consumer prices grew at the slowest pace in six months while factory-gate inflation eased for the first time since the Iran war broke out in late February, in another sign that reflation momentum is fading as the oil shock subsides and domestic spending languishes.

top_signals.title: Why Trump’s Waiver of the Jones Act Is Unlikely To Lower Gas Prices
top_signals.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is weighing another suspension of the Jones Act as gasoline prices above $4 a gallon threaten to become a liability for Republicans heading into the midterm elections. The move would again open domestic oil and fuel shipments to cheaper foreign-flagged vessels, extending an emergency waiver Trump imposed after the Iran war sent crude prices sharply higher in March.
